# cycle_pipeline (Resource)

Manages a Cycle pipeline (`/v1/pipelines`). Pipelines are ordered stages of steps used to automate builds, deploys, and other hub operations.

`dynamic` is a **one-way** toggle: once enabled it cannot be set back to `false`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A pipeline with no stages. Stages can be added later as normalized JSON.
resource "cycle_pipeline" "empty" {
  name = "Bootstrap"
}

# A disabled pipeline with a single empty stage. `dynamic` is one-way: once
# enabled it cannot be turned back off.
resource "cycle_pipeline" "deploy" {
  name       = "Deploy API"
  disable    = false
  dynamic    = true
  identifier = "deploy-api"

  stages = jsonencode([
    {
      identifier = "build"
      steps      = []
    }
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the pipeline.

### Optional

- `disable` (Boolean) When `true`, the pipeline cannot be triggered. Defaults to `false`.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) When `true`, enables variable interpolation and other advanced logic on this pipeline. This is a one-way toggle: once set to `true` it cannot be set back to `false`. Defaults to `false`.
- `identifier` (String) A human-readable slugged identifier for the pipeline. Automatically generated from the name if not provided.
- `stages` (String) A JSON array of pipeline stages (each with `identifier`, optional `options`, and `steps`). Modeled as normalized JSON because the step-type union is too large for a native schema. Omit the attribute (or pass JSON `null` / `[]`) for a pipeline with no stages.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this pipeline belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the pipeline.
- `state` (String) The current state of the pipeline (e.g. `live`, `deleting`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pipelines are imported using their ID.
terraform import cycle_pipeline.deploy 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
